tasks.title: Harden interaction contract and target resolution
tasks.objective: Turn the existing interaction stub into a reliable, testable contract with explicit eligibility, prompt, change notification, and dispatch behavior, without adding carry or UI.
acceptance: IInteractable exposes InteractionPrompt, CanInteract(GameObject), and Interact(GameObject)
SimpleInteractable remains eligible by default, can be disabled, and raises its event only when eligible
PlayerInteractor exposes CurrentInteractable, CurrentTarget, CurrentPrompt, InteractKey, InteractKeyLabel, and a testable TryInteract path
Target/prompt changes are observable without polling private state
Out-of-range, blocked, disabled, and paused interactions never dispatch
The interaction key is defined in one interaction-owned field and exposed for prompt display; UI does not hardcode E
Existing PlayerControllerTests still pass and new coverage verifies eligibility, prompt, and notification behavior
Compile, EditMode, PlayMode, and log scan pass

tasks.title: Implement carry state, item identity, and drop/place rules
tasks.objective: Add one-item carrying with explicit hold attachment, drop, and placement rules, define LaundryItem identity and kinds, and protect against duplication and loss through normal and interrupted interactions.
acceptance: LaundryItemKind defines Basket, LooseLaundry, and Bag; LaundryItem owns TemplateId, InstanceId, kind, and carry eligibility
TemplateId is a non-empty prefab-template identifier; InstanceId is unique per spawned instance and remains stable while the instance exists
CarryController is on the Player prefab through an idempotent editor setup path and supports at most one held item
Pickup attaches the item to an explicit hold anchor and disables its world physics/collider safely
Drop restores the item to a valid world state; a blocked drop uses a safe fallback that does not lose or teleport the item into geometry
CarrySlot placement succeeds only for an empty compatible slot and rejects occupied or incompatible slots
No-stuck safeguards cover held item destroyed or disabled while carried, CarryController disabled or scene unloaded while holding, blocked drop, and double interaction in one frame
Automated tests prove no duplication or loss of the item instance
Player prefab setup/validation is idempotent
Compile, EditMode carry tests, PlayMode pickup/drop/place tests, and log scan pass

Phase3SetupTool validation rejects duplicate/blank TemplateIds, missing colliders, missing LaundryItem components, missing materials, and route-blocking placement

tasks.title: Add interaction prompt UI and controls hint
tasks.objective: Add a readable placeholder interaction prompt that names the target and action, shows the interaction key from PlayerInteractor, and hides cleanly when no valid target or the game is paused.
acceptance: InteractionPromptView is an IMGUI placeholder on the Player prefab, documented as temporary pending the UI phase
InteractionPromptView exposes testable IsVisible and CurrentLabel state that OnGUI renders from
It subscribes to PlayerInteractor change notifications and displays only when the current interaction is eligible
Prompt text combines the interactable prompt with the interaction key label sourced from PlayerInteractor
Prompt hides when there is no target, the target becomes ineligible, or the game is paused, including Time.timeScale == 0
The prompt does not steal focus or cursor state from PauseController and uses no new package or font asset
PlayMode coverage verifies visible/hidden transitions and the displayed key label
Compile, PlayMode suites, and log scan pass

tasks.title: Add one machine load/unload interaction hook
tasks.objective: Add a single washer load/unload interaction target that accepts one LooseLaundry item, rejects invalid or occupied loads, and returns the exact same item on unload without implementing machine cycles.
acceptance: One existing washer exposes a load/unload interaction target without moving, rescaling, or restructuring existing room geometry
A Git checkpoint is recorded before editing GreyboxRoom.prefab; the hook is additive-only and existing room geometry is preserved
An empty slot accepts one LooseLaundry item and rejects Basket, Bag, and already-occupied loads without changing ownership
Invalid loads are rejected with a clear prompt/result and leave both the item and slot unchanged
Unload returns the exact same item instance and leaves the slot empty
Double-load and double-unload attempts cannot duplicate or lose an item
Phase3SetupTool is re-appliable after a GreyboxRoom rebuild and ValidateMachineHook fails loudly if the hook is missing or duplicated
Phase 3 asset validation and Phase 2 navigation/camera validation still pass
Compile, EditMode load-rule tests, PlayMode load/unload tests, and log scan pass
